an10.94:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggārāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre,
an10.94:1.2: atha kho vajjiyamāhito gahapati divā divassa campāyā nikkhami bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an10.94:2.1: atha kho vajjiyamāhito gahapati yenaññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkami.
an10.94:2.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṅgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentā nisinnā honti.
an10.94:3.1: addasaṃsu kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ. disvā aññamaññaṃ saṇṭhapesuṃ
an10.94:3.2: appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddamakattha,
an10.94:3.3: ayaṃ vajjiyamāhito gahapati āgacchati, samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako,
an10.94:3.4: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā campāyaṃ paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro. vajjiyamāhito gahapati
an10.94:3.5: appasaddakāmā kho pana te ayasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino
an10.94:3.6: appevanāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
an10.94:4.1: atha kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
an10.94:4.2: atha kho vajjiyamāhito gahapati yena te paribbājakā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi.
an10.94:4.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ te paribbājakā etadavocuṃ:
an10.94:4.4: “saccaṃ kira gahapati samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadatī’ti?
an10.94:4.5: na kho bhante bhagavā sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, na pi sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadati.
an10.94:4.6: gārayhaṃ kho pana bhante bhagavā garahati, pāsaṃsiyaṃ pasaṃsati,
an10.94:4.7: gārayhaṃ kho pana bhante bhagavā garahanto, pāsaṃsīyaṃ pasaṃsanto vibhajjavādo bhagavā.
an10.94:5.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro paribbājako vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
an10.94:5.2: “āgamehi tvaṃ gahapati yassa tvaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsasi so samaṇo gotamo venayiko appaññattikotī.
an10.94:5.6: iti kusalākusalaṃ bhagavā paññāpayamāno sappaññattiko bhagavā,
an10.94:6.1: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyante appaṭibhānā nisīdiṃsu.
an10.94:6.2: atha kho vajjiyamāhito gahapati te paribbājake tuṇhībhūte maṅkubhūte pattakkhandhe adhomukhe pajjhāyante appaṭibhāne viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an10.94:6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vajjiyamāhito gahapati yāvatako ahosi tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an10.94:7.2: evaṃ kho te gahapati moghapurisā kālena kālaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetabbā.
an10.94:7.3: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ tapaṃ tapitabbanti vadāmi,
an10.94:7.4: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ tapaṃ na tapitabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.5: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ samādānaṃ samādātabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.6: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ samādānaṃ na samādātabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.7: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ padhānaṃ padahitabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.8: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ padhānaṃ na padahitabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.9: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbo paṭinissaggo paṭinissajitabboti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.10: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbo paṭinissaggo na paṭinissajitabboti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.11: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbā vimutti vimuccitabbāti vadāmi,
an10.94:7.12: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbā vimutti na vimuccitabbāti vadāmi.
an10.94:8.1: yaṃ hi gahapati tapaṃ tapato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, . kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ tapaṃ na tapitabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:8.2: yañcakhvāssa gahapati tapaṃ tapato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpaṃ tapaṃ tapitabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:9.1: yaṃ hi gahapati samādānaṃ samādiyato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ samādānaṃ na samāditabbanti vadāmi,
an10.94:9.2: yañcakhvāssa gahapati samādānaṃ samādiyato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpaṃ samādānaṃ samāditabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:10.1: yaṃ hi gahapati padhānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ padhānaṃ na padahitabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:10.2: yañcakhvāssa gahapati padhānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpaṃ padhānaṃ padahitabbanti vadāmi.
an10.94:11.1: yaṃ gahapati paṭinissaggaṃ paṭinissajjayato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpo paṭinissaggo paṭinissajitabboti vadāmi.
an10.94:11.2: yañcakhvāssa gahapati paṭinisaggaṃ paṭinisajjayato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpo paṭinissaggo na paṭinissajitabboti vadāmi.
an10.94:12.1: yaṃ hi gahapati vimuttiṃ vimuccayato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpā vimutti na vimuccitabbāti vadāmi.
an10.94:12.2: yañcakhvāssa gahapati vimuttiṃ vimuccayato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpā vimutti vimuccitabbāti vadāmīti.
an10.94:13.1: atha kho vajjiyamāhito gahapati bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an10.94:14.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkante vajjiyamāhite gahapatimhi bhikkhu āmantesi
an10.94:14.2: yo pi so bhikkhave bhikkhu dīgharattaṃ apparajakkho imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, so pi evameva aññatitthiye paribbājake sahadhammena suniggatahiṃ niggaṇheyya yathā taṃ vajjiyamāhitena gahapatinā niggahītāti.
